## Why

Main CI failed once on `set_member_roles: cancel during a group re-read reports Cancelled` (changed 101, expected 100). It looked flaky, but it caught a real bug that #513 has since fixed: a cancel that landed during a group re-read which still completed let one more role change go out.

The paginator stops at `MAX_PAGINATED_RESULTS = 50,000` without setting a

sleeps until the reset window (up to 60 seconds). This prevents 429 errors but
means methods can pause mid-execution.

   `modelRequiresVault` is model-wide: any resource with a sensitive field (or `sensitiveOutput`).
   `isMutatingKind(k)` is `k !== "read" && k !== "list"`.
2. **Kind inference is exact-name only** (`model.ts` `inferMethodKind`): `get/read/describe/show`→read,
   `list/search/find`→list, `create`, `update/patch`, `delete/destroy/remove`. Generated names like
   `list_api_keys` / `get_synthetics_test` infer `undefined` = mutating, so today every generated read
   in a model with any sensitive resource is refused without a vault. Fix: emit `kind` explicitly.
